description:
## Why

Walk every file flagged by the 2026-05-11 grep and strip Category-A version-gating language. Keep Category B and C untouched. Replace '(tracked for v0.x)' with '(tracked as PKIX-xxx)' when a bead exists; file a follow-up bead and link it if none does.

## Files (per 2026-05-11 grep)

### Affected — Category-A strip required

```
AGENTS.md                                          # handled by .1, do not touch here

pkix-revocation-http/src/extract.rs:76             # 'out of scope for v0.x of this helper' → strip v0.x qualifier
pkix-revocation-http/src/crl.rs:53                 # 'for v0.x we lump cert-level malformation' → 'we currently lump'

pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:464                     # 'tracked for v0.2' → 'tracked as PKIX-xxx' or just describe
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:541                     # '# Limitations (v0.1)' → '# Limitations' (drop qualifier, keep section)
pkix-revocation/tests/pkits_4_5.rs:22,23           # 'v0.1 does not / deferred to v0.2' → describe current state

pkix-difftest/README.md:195,205,219                # '(currently just / out of v0.1 harness scope / Out of scope for v0.1)'
pkix-difftest/python/limbo-to-pem-tree.py:25,69    # 'out of v0.1 harness scope' / 'pkix-difftest v0.1 scope'
pkix-difftest/baseline-pyca.md:3,25,59,69,90,94    # 'v0.1 deliverable / v0.1 input contract / v0.1 baseline / v0.1 differential harness / v0.1 surfaces'
pkix-difftest/baseline-pkits-analysis.md:81        # 'pkix-path does not support DSA in v0.1'
pkix-difftest/src/main.rs:3                        # 'v0.1, PKIX-7nsf.1'
pkix-difftest/src/lib.rs:13,120,131                # 'v0.1 status / Limitation (v0.1) / Always true in v0.1'
pkix-difftest/src/oracles/pyca.rs:13               # 'for v0.1 (PKITS = 249 chains × 30ms)'
pkix-difftest/src/oracles/mod.rs:7                 # 'v0.1 status'
pkix-difftest/src/corpus/pem_tree.rs:101           # 'for v0.1'
pkix-difftest/src/oracles/pkix_path.rs:45          # 'root_in_chain = false is not supported in v0.1'

pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:376                     # 'out of scope for v0.2' → strip
pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:66,262                        # 'planned for v0.3' → describe current state

pkix-ct/src/lib.rs:44,102                          # 'not yet implemented (tracked for v0.2)' → '(tracked as PKIX-baac)'

pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:482                   # 'implementation tracked in pkix-chain-simple v0.1' — read context, decide

pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:202,210,449               # 'planned for v0.3'
pkix-profiles/README.md:82                         # 'profiles are planned for v0.3'

pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_1_4_2.rs:46-121            # 8 #[ignore = '... not supported in v0.1 (tracked for v0.2)'] reasons
pkix-path/tests/pkits_4_6_4_7.rs:403,406,421       # 'v0.1 does not check cRLSign'
pkix-path/README.md:99                             # 'transcoding is deferred to v0.3'
```

### Do not touch (Category B or C or untouchable)

- All 24 `# Limitations` rustdoc sections (Category C; one exception: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:541 has `(v0.1)` qualifier to strip, section body stays).
- All 'out of scope for THIS CRATE' partition statements in pkix-path/src/lib.rs, pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs, pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs, pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs, pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:463, pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:640, pkix-revocation-http/src/extract.rs:104,153 — Category B.
- `specs/*` — vendored RFCs and CABF BR.
- CHANGELOG.md historical entries (lines 352, 375).

## Rewrite patterns

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| `(tracked for v0.2)` | `(tracked as PKIX-xxx)` if bead exists; else file bead and link |
| `planned for v0.3 via X` | `planned via X` or describe-only |
| `v0.1 does not support X` | `Does not currently support X` |
| `# Limitations (v0.1)` | `# Limitations` |
| `(deferred to v0.2)` in #[ignore] | `(tracked as PKIX-xxx)` |

## Acceptance

- [ ] `rg -n 'v0\.[0-9]|tracked for v|deferred to v|planned for v|out of scope for v|in v0\.' --glob '!specs/' --glob '!CHANGELOG.md' --glob '!target' --glob '!.beads'` returns zero matches in tracked source files.
- [ ] Every Category-A removal that referenced a follow-up version has a linked PKIX-xxx bead, OR has had a new bead filed and linked.
- [ ] No `# Limitations` section body deleted; only the `(v0.1)` qualifier on one heading.
- [ ] Compile clean: `cargo check --workspace --all-features`.
- [ ] Test runs unchanged: `cargo test --workspace --all-features` (ignore reasons changed but ignored tests still ignored).

## Depends on
